reviews.title: Great for PS5 and daily use - Very smooth!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D16xioJ2mWL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51YIzXFs0KL._SY256.jpg I’m really happy with this monitor. It works great and feels very fast. The graphics and resolution are excellent for the price. We mainly got it for gaming, and it’s been fantastic for the PS5. We checked the settings, and it seems to be running at 120Hz, which makes the gameplay feel super smooth. It’s also been perfect for regular daily use.
I saw some comments about the stand quality being a bit "cheap," but honestly, it’s not an issue for us at all. It feels steady enough and looks good on the desk. Overall, it’s a solid purchase if you want a high-quality screen without spending a fortune!
reviews.author: Julissa M

reviews.title: Perfec Setup For Me - 2 Screens
reviews.comment: GREAT price on this monitor. As an author with a new program that requires me to have two screens, I wanted a good brand at a good price. Couldn't beat this one. Set up was fairly easy. I needed a Display Port cable and it only came with a HDMI cable. Not a big deal. Just had to go buy one. Easy to set up. Easy to assemble. Once my son explained how to use it, getting right screen on right side, (Y'all understand this, I do not, but I did it anyway) it worked beautifully. I only need it for a new program I purchased. That on one side, and my Word document open on the other screen. Color seems good, YouTube videos sound good on it, good quality, I don't game so, I can't speak to that. I assume it would be fine.
reviews.author: DDW

reviews.title: Amazing monitor
reviews.comment: I have tried couple of monitors and this one is just awesome. Really fast (mouse moving around) and high quality screen. Cables is included. Brightness is awesome. Value of money is great. The best 24" monitor I'd say.
reviews.author: Ali

reviews.title: Good monitor Horrible stand
reviews.comment: Monitor itself is very decent for the price. I use it to play games as 1080p offers higher performance on my PC. The brightness is okay, nothing to write home about very typical at this price point not bad not amazing, the 120hz works and looks great, the color is decent out of the box but I recommend following a guide to get it more accurate (also normal at this price point). The stand that comes with the monitor is terrible, simply by me putting my hand on the desk to grab my mouse causes the monitor to jiggle pretty hard for a few seconds I ended up buying a monitor stand to replace the factory stand and it solved the issue
